name: dawai
description: Dawai - pharmacy POS sold as SaaS: the API, the shop app, the operator console, the marketing site and the Data API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/site install && npm --prefix apps/data-api install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,shop,console -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm run dev -w @dawai/shop" "npm run dev -w @dawai/console"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm run build -w @dawai/shop -w @dawai/console && npm --prefix apps/site run build && npm --prefix apps/data-api run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix apps/site run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/data-api run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api run test && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix apps/data-api run test
